verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs describe AirDrop for sending files from any folder between Mac, iPhone, and iPad, even without a Wi-Fi network. Universal Clipboard and Continuity drag-and-drop also move entire files between nearby devices. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of AirDrop transfers, documentation of proximity/pairing requirements and transfer limits.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can send files wirelessly between nearby paired devices

citations.quote: With a few clicks on your Mac, you can take a file from any folder and use AirDrop to send it from one device to the other. It even works without a Wi-Fi network.
AirDrop makes sharing files between Mac, iPhone, and iPad simple.
You can even copy and paste entire files between two Mac systems.
You can even drag and drop a video from your Mac to your iPhone, so you can continue editing on the go.
